final_result.interpretation: Mean of paired per-seed Sharpe changes, not ensemble returns. Seeds and overlapping bootstrap samples are not independent market histories.
final_result.scope: Single reserved market period; no further selection or tuning on these outcomes.

development.scope: Reused development, not untouched test; no adjustment for adaptive method search
development.interpretation: Primary estimate averages per-seed Sharpe improvements, not an ensemble return. One common time-index draw is used across all seeds. Three seeds give limited training-variation resolution; a bootstrap cannot undo development search.

provenance.seed_rule: 42 fixed before final test; 123/456 are replications
provenance.explanation: Deterministic explanation of recorded strategy weights and executed accounting, not generated model reasoning.
provenance.future_information: Only signal-close inputs enter allocation explanations. Realized later outcomes are labeled separately.
provenance.scope: Five fixed ETFs; not live brokerage, stock picking, or news forecasting. No GPU model is loaded by this replay UI.
